name: B2B Sales Pipeline Kanban Board
description: Verify the enterprise Kanban board displays 5 stage columns, financial aggregate ribbon, deal cards, and quick filters

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@flowcrm.local and navigate to /pipeline
Verify the Financial Aggregate Ribbon displays Total Pipeline, Weighted Forecast, Open Deals, and Win Rate KPI cards
Verify the 5 stages are rendered: 'Discovery & Qualified', 'Technical Evaluation', 'Proposal & Quote', 'Contract Negotiation', and 'Closed Won'
Verify enterprise deal cards are visible with deal title, uppercase company name, formatted amount, priority badge, and activity pill
Click '+ New Deal' to open the creation modal
Verify the 'Create New Deal' modal dialog is displayed with input fields
